current_point.claim: 提出了一种面向大规模动态图的图神经网络优化机制，该机制统一利用图摘要技术压缩图结构以降低计算和内存开销，并针对时序图表示学习和分布式训练两种场景分别构建了GSAERU和DSGNN模型，实现了大规模动态图的高效处理。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed an optimization mechanism for graph neural networks on large-scale dynamic graphs, which uniformly utilizes graph summarization technology to compress graph structures for reducing computational and memory overhead, and constructs GSAERU and DSGNN models for sequential graph representation learning and distributed training respectively, achieving efficient processing of large-scale dynamic graphs.
technical_features: 利用图摘要技术压缩图结构以降低计算和内存开销
构建用于大规模时序图表示学习的GSAERU模型
构建用于分布式图神经网络优化训练的DSGNN模型
通过压缩后的图以自编码器或小批量训练方式进行高效的表示学习和训练
technical_features_en: Exploit graph summarization technology to compress graph structures to reduce computation and memory overhead
Construct GSAERU model for large-scale sequential graph representation learning
Construct DSGNN model for distributed graph neural network optimization training
Perform efficient representation learning and training on compressed graphs via autoencoder or mini-batch training
